values: 9700002 / AMR-096-0002: Aldous congestion toy model; joint designed-tree outer phases

A designed tree model with a sharp congestion–fragmentation transition — Alec Kriebel (ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0 (2026-10-21). Five-page unrefereed research note: an exact specialized existence model motivated by Aldous's conceptual request, with a complete analytic joint marginal-admission/spare-connectivity theorem. Sparse binary physical trees carry dense k² cross-root streams; positive linear capacity prices give the unique cheapest doubled-unit-demand design, with capacities growing with k. Independent fixed-law Exp(1) affine slopes have quadratic time variance; exact finite right marginal uses the actual offered slope. The explicit all-cuts bound confines both changes to width16sqrt(log(k)/k) with high probability; every optimizer has the whole tree spare below the lower endpoint and every edge saturated above the upper endpoint. Width is an upper bound, not optimal scaling; no critical r(2), generic-network, adaptive-growth, canonical-right-model or first-transition claim. Classical transport/concentration, HOT, prior congestion/percolation models and Aldous's2005 tree-realism reservation credited. Bounded primary priority audit found no authenticated exact earlier construction/theorem; final1993 KMN journal body, unindexed/unpublished work and editions remain coverage limits. Three independent mathematical/source families and sequential new full-package AI adversarial reviews completed after repairs. Original24 files preserved; PDF plus editable-source/verification ZIP and a narrowly tested replay derivative with exact active output and only enumerated old diagnostic allowances. Historical unpinned byte replay is not claimed. Extensive AI use in research, proof/model development, computation, writing and auditing; no formal independent human peer review.
